shapes: Above the eta there is one connected wavy mark: it starts low at the left with a short downward tail, rises to a heavy, thick hump, dips, then rises to a high pointed end at the upper right. Together this is a tilde-shaped circumflex. Its left half is unusually heavy and extends low, so a psili fused into the left end cannot be ruled out, but no separate breathing blob can be seen. Nothing sits below the eta, and there are no diaeresis dots.
